resume: MODELAR is a semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four oscillators sound continuously and modulate each other. The keyboard does not play notes, it moves a cursor on an XY pad that opens the filter, pushes cross-modulation and brings in the effects. K1 to K4 are always the four volumes.

commandes.role: The active oscillator's pitch, minus a semitone (held: repeats). With SEL: minus an octave. OCT- and OCT+ together: the pitch returns to 0 (with SEL: all four).
The active oscillator's pitch, plus a semitone (held: repeats). With SEL: plus an octave.
Opens or closes the FX page (held: open while held): VCF, VCA, drive, fold, ring, chorus, delay, reverb, crush, level. With SEL: bypasses the effects.
SHIFT: held, or press twice to lock it (its LED blinks), one more press to release it.
ENV page: the generative environment (CALMA, NEBBIA, MAREA, FORESTA, VETRO, RUGGINE, COSMO, TEMPESTA), drift, its speed, mutation, density. With SEL: Mutate.
LFO page: two LFOs (shape, free or synced speed, destination, amount; they can also move the cursor) and the clock (speed, source, swing, jitter). With SEL: LFO sync.
EDIT page: two destinations each for X and Y, with their amounts; slew, attack, release, release mode (fade, stay, return), range, curve, gesture size and speed. With SEL: default settings.
GLO page: press a key to set it (white: point, intensity, oscillators, X and Y destinations, snapshot; black: gesture, speed, size, center, intensity, oscillators, X and Y). With SEL: key copy.

Switches from the KAOS PAD to the four bars (volume, wave and pitch of each oscillator); goes back one page. With SEL: the SYSTEM page (MIDI channel, MIDI notes, CC out, colors, lights, version, audio load).
Saves the patch in its slot. With SEL: the slots (load, save, rename); held 2 s, quick save.
ARP page: mode, speed, gate, glide, swing, latch, spread. With SEL: ARP on or off.
SEQ page: pattern, track length and mutation, speed, swing, direction. With SEL: choose the pattern.
Starts or stops. With SEL: tap tempo.
Records: live during playback, step by step when stopped. With SEL: clears the active track (+ PLAY: the whole pattern).
Master volume. At startup, the volumes are at 0: raise it, then K1 to K4.
The active oscillator (1 to 4). With SEL: the clock speed, in Hz. In a page: the row.
The active oscillator's wave. With SEL: loads the next or previous patch. In a page: the row's parameter.
The routing (1 to 8). With SEL: effects dry/wet. In a page: the value.

The 16 points of the pad, a 4 by 4 grid: the group of four gives Y, the position in the group gives X. Several keys held: the cursor sits between them. With SEL: HOLD, the cursor stays. On SEQ: steps 1 to 16 of the page.

Eleven gestures, from F#3 to F#5: circle, figure eight, horizontal sweep, vertical, diagonal, spiral, tremolo, walk, bounce, jump, return; the cursor draws them while the key is held. With SEL: LATCH (F#5: stop everything, release HOLD). On SEQ: step pages, KAOS and OSC1 to 4 tracks, copy, clear.

gestes: SEL held or locked (press twice): the "with SEL" column of each control.
FX, ENV, LFO, EDIT, GLO, ARP, SEQ held: the page stays open while held.
OCT- and OCT+ together: the pitch returns to 0.

modes.texte: Raise MASTER, then K1 to K4: each brings in an oscillator. Touch a white key: the cursor glides there and the effect comes in. Hold a black key: the cursor draws a gesture. HOME: the four bars.
In a page, SELECT chooses the row, PRESETS the parameter and ALGORITHM the value.

a_savoir: The clock is set in Hz, not BPM: internal, MIDI or OSC4, with swing, jitter and tap tempo.
MIDI: incoming clock with start and stop; CC 12 X, 13 Y, 14 to 17 the volumes, 21 to 24 the waves, 70 algo, 71 resonance, 74 cutoff, 91 reverb, 93 chorus, 94 delay.
